title: Synapse-Control: Making Agent Experience Actionable with Lightweight Runtime Control
abstract: arXiv:2611.13615v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model agents reuse execution experience to improve reliability on complex tool-based tasks. Systems such as Sentry call large models to generate failure diagnoses before retrieving advice, adding inference cost to experience reuse. We present Synapse-Control, an agent runtime whose lightweight control plane selects advice and determines when to send it to the task-executing model. Rules shortlist relevant advice, and a lightweight 1.7B classifier fine-tuned on teacher-labeled state-suggestion pairs scores those candidates instead of generating a diagnosis. Micro-contracts encode reusable interface checks, such as required arguments or valid options, without prescribing complete task programs. A Prompt Value Table records earlier guidance and feedback to limit repeated suggestions through cooldown and token-budget checks. Across 1,308 attempts per method in AppWorld and WebShop, Synapse-Control achieves 270 successes (29.

translated_title: Synapse-Control：通过轻量级运行时控制使智能体经验可操作化
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型智能体通过复用执行经验来提高其在复杂工具使用任务上的可靠性。诸如Sentry之类的系统在检索建议之前需要调用大模型生成失败诊断，这为经验复用增加了推理成本。我们提出Synapse-Control，这是一个智能体运行时，其轻量级控制平面负责选择建议并决定何时将其发送给执行任务的模型。规则首先筛选出相关建议，然后由一个在教师标注的状态-建议对上微调的轻量级1.7B分类器对这些候选建议进行评分，而不是生成诊断。微合同编码了可复用的接口检查，例如必需参数或有效选项，而无需规定完整的任务程序。提示价值表记录先前的指导和反馈，通过冷却机制和令牌预算检查来限制重复建议。在AppWorld和WebShop上每种方法进行1,308次尝试的评测中，Synapse-Control实现了270次成功（29.（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Synapse-Control用一个轻量级智能体运行时控制平面（规则筛选、1.7B微调分类器评分、微合同接口检查和提示价值表冷却机制）取代大模型失败诊断，以更低的推理成本实现智能体执行经验的高效复用与精准投放。
en_tdlr: Synapse-Control is a lightweight agent runtime control plane that combines rule-based shortlisting, a fine-tuned 1.7B classifier, micro-contracts, and a prompt value table to select and time advice delivery, eliminating costly LLM-generated failure diagnoses while making agent experience actionable.
